name: LED
rules: Current flows long leg (anode, +) to short leg (cathode, −, the flat side). Backwards, it stays dark.
On its own it takes all the current it can get, and burns out.
Forward voltage: red 2.0 · yellow 2.05 · green 2.15 · blue 3.0 V.
flavor: Electrons drop into holes and give off the difference as light.
